alt: Step chart of cumulative victim loss across 236 sandwiches on Uniswap v3 WETH/USDT 0.01% from 5 to 11 October 2026, ranked by loss. The status-quo curve rises steeply over the first 20 sandwiches and ends at $12,387. The same orders replayed through Chan, Wu and Shi's per-block clearing end at $3,041. A dashed line at zero marks the case where attackers stop, since no attack makes money under the mechanism.
